```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

source("R/setup.R")

# Toggle: set to TRUE to save figures and tables to disk
save_outputs <- FALSE

output_dir <- here("output", "figures")
if (save_outputs && !dir.exists(output_dir)) dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)

# Load processed data
gic_descriptive <- readRDS(here("data", "processed", "gic_descriptive.rds"))
gic_models <- gic_descriptive$gic_models
ae_long <- gic_descriptive$ae_long
ae_long_grouped <- gic_descriptive$ae_long_grouped
ae_cycle_long <- gic_descriptive$ae_cycle_long
ae_cycle_measured <- gic_descriptive$ae_cycle_measured
cycle_summary <- gic_descriptive$cycle_summary
cycle_summary_grouped <- gic_descriptive$cycle_summary_grouped
grade_cols <- gic_descriptive$grade_cols
rm(gic_descriptive)
```


# Comprehensive Descriptive Table

```{r}
#| label: prep-tbl-desc
#| include: false

show_p <- TRUE

# Patient-level "any event" flag per collapsed AE category (MET-007)
ae_group_pt <- ae_long_grouped |>
  group_by(record_id, ae_group) |>
  summarize(any_event = as.integer(max(grade) > 0), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from   = ae_group,
    values_from  = any_event,
    values_fill  = 0,
    names_prefix = "aegrp_"
  )

aegrp_cols <- names(ae_group_pt)[startsWith(names(ae_group_pt), "aegrp_")]

# Single source data frame with all factor conversions
tbl_desc_dat <- gic_models |>
  left_join(ae_group_pt, by = "record_id") |>
  mutate(
    across(all_of(aegrp_cols), ~ factor(.x, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes"))),
    ae_any_pt        = factor(ae_any_pt, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")),
    ae_severe_any_pt = factor(ae_severe_any_pt, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes"))
  )

tbl_opts <- list(
  by           = "hiv_status",
  statistic    = list(all_continuous() ~ "{median} ({p25}–{p75})",
                      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"),
  digits       = all_continuous() ~ 1,
  missing      = "ifany",
  missing_text = "Missing"
)

mk_block <- function(vars, labels, types = NULL, with_p = show_p) {
  args <- c(
    list(data = tbl_desc_dat |> select(hiv_status, all_of(vars)),
         include = all_of(vars), label = labels),
    tbl_opts
  )
  if (!is.null(types)) args$type <- types

  tbl <- do.call(tbl_summary, args) |>
    add_overall(last = FALSE) |>
    add_stat_label(
      label = list(
        all_categorical() ~ "n (% of group)",
        all_continuous()  ~ "Median (IQR)"
      )
    )

  if (with_p) {
    tbl <- tbl |>
      add_p(
        test = list(all_continuous() ~ "wilcox.test",
                    all_categorical() ~ "fisher.test"),
        pvalue_fun = ~ map_chr(.x, format_p)
      )
  }
  tbl
}

t_patient <- mk_block(
  c("age", "sex"),
  list(age ~ "Age, years", sex ~ "Sex"),
  types = list(age ~ "continuous")
)

t_disease <- mk_block(
  c("cancer_site", "histology", "cancer_stage"),
  list(cancer_site ~ "Cancer site", histology ~ "Histology", cancer_stage ~ "Cancer stage")
)

t_treatment <- mk_block(
  c("tx_intent", "tx_concurrent_rtx", "chemo_type", "cycles_prescribed", "cycles_given"),
  list(tx_intent ~ "Treatment intent", tx_concurrent_rtx ~ "Concurrent radiotherapy",
       chemo_type ~ "Chemotherapy type", cycles_prescribed ~ "Cycles prescribed",
       cycles_given ~ "Cycles received"),
  types = list(cycles_prescribed ~ "continuous", cycles_given ~ "continuous")
)

t_comorbid <- mk_block(
  c("comorbid_htn", "comorbid_dm", "comorbid_tb", "comorbid_asthma",
    "comorbid_chd", "comorbid_none"),
  list(comorbid_htn ~ "Hypertension", comorbid_dm ~ "Diabetes",
       comorbid_tb ~ "Tuberculosis", comorbid_asthma ~ "Asthma",
       comorbid_chd ~ "Coronary heart disease", comorbid_none ~ "No comorbidities")
)

t_history <- mk_block(
  c("hx_etoh", "hx_tobacco", "hx_cancer", "residence"),
  list(hx_etoh ~ "Alcohol history", hx_tobacco ~ "Tobacco history",
       hx_cancer ~ "Prior cancer", residence ~ "Residence")
)
```

# Completion Rate by HIV Status
Proportion of patients who completed treatment cycle $k$ from the population of patients prescribed at least $k$ cycles.
```{r}
#| label: plt-cycle-completion

survival_data <- gic_models |>
  # for each patient, create a row for each cycle they were prescribed
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(cycle = list(1:cycles_prescribed)) |>
  unnest(cycle) |>
  # mark whether they actually received each cycle
  mutate(received = cycle <= cycles_given) |>
  # for each HIV status and cycle number, get the proportion who received it
  group_by(hiv_status, cycle) |>
  summarise(
    n_prescribed = n(),
    prop_received = mean(received),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# main plot (store it)
p_main <- ggplot(survival_data, aes(x = cycle, y = prop_received, color = hiv_status)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Chemotherapy Cycle Completion by HIV Status",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Proportion receiving cycle\n(among those prescribed at least that many)",
    color = "HIV status"
  ) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 0, 5))

# table underneath
p_table <- ggplot(survival_data, aes(x = cycle, y = hiv_status, label = n_prescribed)) +
  geom_text(size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12, limits = range(survival_data$cycle)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, subtitle = "Patients prescribed at least k cycles") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 5, 5, 5)
  )

# combine
p_main / p_table + plot_layout(heights = c(4, 1))
```

# Hospitalization
```{r}
#| label: prep-hosp-days
#| include: false

hosp_cols <- names(gic_models)[str_detect(names(gic_models), "^hosp_days_([1-9]|1[0-2])$")]

hosp_long <- gic_models |> 
  select(record_id, hiv_status, cycles_given, age, sex, cancer_stage, chemo_type, all_of(hosp_cols)) |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(hosp_cols),
    names_to = "cycle_var",
    values_to = "hosp_days"
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    cycle = as.integer(str_extract(cycle_var, "\\d+"))
  )

# Patient-level summaries
hosp_pt <- hosp_long |> 
  group_by(record_id, hiv_status, cycles_given) |> 
  summarize(
    hosp_days_total = sum(hosp_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    hosp_days_per_cycle_given = if_else(is.na(cycles_given) | cycles_given <= 0,
                                        NA_real_,
                                        hosp_days_total / cycles_given)
  )

```

```{r}
#| label: prep-hosp-cycle-data

# Identify cycle-level column groups needed for hospitalization analysis
severe_cols <- names(gic_models)[str_detect(names(gic_models), "^ae_n_severe_([1-9]|1[0-2])$")]
max_grade_cols <- names(gic_models)[str_detect(names(gic_models), "^ae_max_grade_([1-9]|1[0-2])$")]
measured_cols <- names(gic_models)[str_detect(names(gic_models), "^ae_n_markers_measured_([1-9]|1[0-2])$")]

# Pivot each set of cycle cols to long
pivot_cycle_cols <- function(df, cols, value_name) {
  df |>
    select(record_id, all_of(cols)) |>
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(cols), names_to = "cycle_var", values_to = value_name) |>
    mutate(cycle = as.integer(str_extract(cycle_var, "\\d+$"))) |>
    select(-cycle_var)
}

severe_long <- pivot_cycle_cols(gic_models, severe_cols,    "ae_n_severe")
max_grade_long <- pivot_cycle_cols(gic_models, max_grade_cols, "ae_max_grade")
measured_long <- pivot_cycle_cols(gic_models, measured_cols,  "ae_n_markers_measured")

# Join AE variables to hospitalization data
hosp_severe_cycle <- hosp_long |>
  left_join(severe_long,   by = c("record_id", "cycle")) |>
  left_join(measured_long, by = c("record_id", "cycle")) |>
  mutate(ae_measured = ae_n_markers_measured > 0)

hosp_maxgrade_cycle <- hosp_long |>
  left_join(max_grade_long, by = c("record_id", "cycle")) |>
  left_join(measured_long,  by = c("record_id", "cycle")) |>
  mutate(ae_measured = ae_n_markers_measured > 0)
```


```{r}
#| label: plt-hosp-vs-max-grade
#| fig-cap: "Mean hospital days vs max AE grade in cycle, by HIV status (among measured cycles)"

hosp_maxgrade_summ <- hosp_maxgrade_cycle |>
  filter(ae_measured) |>
  group_by(hiv_status, ae_max_grade) |>

    mean_hosp_days = mean(hosp_days, na.rm = TRUE),
```

# Early Dropout

```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(gtsummary)

# ==========================================
# 1. DATA RE-PREPARATION (Fresh Document)
# ==========================================

# Variables defined in your global environment or constants
early_dropout_cycles <- 4 

# Recreate patient-level early dropout flags
gic_dropout_base <- gic_models |>
  mutate(
    early_dropout = as.integer(
      cycles_given <= early_dropout_cycles & cycles_prescribed > early_dropout_cycles
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(early_dropout), !is.na(hiv_status))

# Recreate the wide max-grade per AE type dataframe (imputing missing to 0)
ae_wide_fresh <- ae_long_grouped |>
  filter(cycle <= early_dropout_cycles, !is.na(grade)) |>
  group_by(record_id, ae_group) |>
  summarize(max_grade_early = max(grade, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = ae_group, values_from = max_grade_early, values_fill = 0)

# Merge back to baseline patient details
dropout_model_data <- gic_dropout_base |>
  select(record_id, hiv_status, early_dropout) |>
  left_join(ae_wide_fresh, by = "record_id") |>
  # Replace any remaining missing values for patients missing completely from ae_long
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ replace_na(.x, 0)))

# Identify the AE columns dynamically for the loop
ae_columns <- setdiff(names(ae_wide_fresh), "record_id")

# Identify sparse columns (fewer than 5 occurrences with grade > 0 in an HIV branch)
sparse_ae <- dropout_model_data |>
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(ae_columns), names_to = "ae_type", values_to = "grade") |>
  group_by(ae_type, hiv_status) |>
  summarize(n_any = sum(grade > 0), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(n_any < 5) |>
  pull(ae_type) |>
  unique()

# Drop sparse variables from modeling consideration
final_ae_columns <- setdiff(ae_columns, sparse_ae)


# ==========================================
# 2. GENERATE CONDENSED GT SUMMARY TABLE
# ==========================================

# Part A: Sample Counts and Descriptive Rates
tbl_descriptive <- dropout_model_data |>
  select(early_dropout, hiv_status, all_of(final_ae_columns)) |>
  mutate(early_dropout = factor(early_dropout, labels = c("Completed Treatment", "Early Dropout"))) |>
  tbl_summary(
    by = early_dropout,
    missing = "no",
    label = list(hiv_status ~ "HIV Status")
  )

# Part B: HIV-Adjusted Univariate Regressions
tbl_regression_mix <- dropout_model_data |>
  select(early_dropout, hiv_status, all_of(final_ae_columns)) |>
  tbl_uvregression(
    method = glm,
    y = early_dropout,
    method.args = list(family = binomial),
    exponentiate = TRUE,
    include = all_of(final_ae_columns),
    # This formula forces every individual AE model to adjust for HIV status
    formula = "{y} ~ {x} + hiv_status", 
    label = map(final_ae_columns, ~ as.formula(paste0(".x ~ '", .x, " Max Grade'")))
  ) |>
  # Apply Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment to p-values across all models
  add_q(method = "BH")

# Combine descriptive data and statistical models side-by-side
table_early_dropout_final <- tbl_merge(
  list(tbl_descriptive, tbl_regression_mix),
  tab_spanner = c("**Descriptive Breakdown**", "**Univariate Association**")
) |>
  bold_labels()
```


```{r}
library(broom)
library(ggplot2)

# Run univariate adjustments in a clean tibble stream
univariate_plot_data <- map_dfr(final_ae_columns, function(at) {
  mod <- glm(
    as.formula(paste0("early_dropout ~ `", at, "` + hiv_status")),
    data   = dropout_model_data,
    family = binomial
  )
  tidy(mod, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) |>
    filter(str_detect(term, fixed(at))) |>
    mutate(ae_type = at)
})

# Draw the modern Forest Plot
ggplot(univariate_plot_data, aes(x = estimate, y = reorder(ae_type, estimate))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  # Using the updated geom_errorbar() with xmin/xmax handles horizontal layout automatically
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0.2, color = "midnightblue", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(color = "firebrick", size = 3) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10)) +
  labs(
    x = "Odds Ratio (95% CI) on Log Scale\n[Adjusted for HIV Status]",
    y = "Adverse Event Type (Max Grade Cycles 1-4)",
    title = "Impact of Early Cycle Toxicities on Early Treatment Dropout",
    subtitle = "Odds of dropping out per 1-unit increase in toxicity grade"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```
